scope: Incremental source triage for AP-0081 through AP-0124; earlier records were compiled before this register existed. A source marked reviewed means the specific Assyrian-connected reports identified during this editorial pass were reconciled, not that the source is complete for all times. Partial sources are deliberately flagged for future research. This audit is not an independent fact-check or link-uptime guarantee.
